description: Connect your AccuRanker account to ChatGPT for instant search intelligence insights. Explore your domains, keywords, rankings, and landing pages. Track historical performance trends and compare KPIs across dates. With an AccuLLM plan, you can also analyze AI search visibility, including brand performance, prompt tracking, and how your brand appears across AI engines. Ask questions about AccuRanker features using the built-in knowledge base.
